caption: The drawing features a single metallic teapot centered on a plain, light-colored background. The teapot is rounded and reflective, depicted in grayscale using soft shading to capture the glossy surface and curved contours. It has a sturdy, wide base, a prominent rounded body with subtle reflective highlights and shadows, a decorative knob atop the lid, and a spout that angles upward to the right with detailed ornamental accents near its base. The handle, attached to the left side, is thick and curves outward and upward, tapering at the ends and featuring similar decorative details to the spout. The composition of the drawing is simple, with the teapot as the only object, centered to draw full attention, while the background is blank except for a faint signature in the lower left corner.
title: Silver Teapot
